headline: Start Aaron Jones over Khalil Shakir in your open FLEX before tonight's Bills-Lions kickoff at 5:15 PM PT.
summary: Danny is 1-0 with a Thursday-kickoff decision to make: Jordan Mason is headed to IR with a fractured thumb, handing Aaron Jones the Vikings' lead-back job, while Khalil Shakir is stuck as Buffalo's third read. Everything else in the lineup is set right, and the only injury concerns (Burrow, Juwan Johnson) look on track to play Sunday.

lineup.why: Jones is now Minnesota's unquestioned lead back after Jordan Mason's thumb injury; Shakir is still Buffalo's third read behind D.J. Moore and Dalton Kincaid.
lineup.evidence: Jordan Mason is going on injured reserve with a fractured thumb, making Jones the Vikings' clear RB1 with an expected ~15 touches vs. Chicago (DK Network, Sep 16, 2026). Shakir posted a 22% adjusted target share and was Buffalo's third read in Week 1, behind Moore and Kincaid, with Moore's presence capping his target share going forward (Week 2 usage report, Sep 17, 2026).

subs.why: Burrow (back) was a limited practice participant Thursday after DNP Wednesday and is trending to play, but has no final designation yet (Cincinnati Bengals injury report, Sep 17, 2026); set Willis, whose game kicks off later, as the AutoSub before Sunday's 10:00 AM PT kickoff.

Johnson (illness) did not practice Wednesday but has a good chance to play Sunday (RotoWire, Sep 16, 2026); no other tight end on Danny's bench is eligible for the slot, so watch the injury report and decide by roughly 8:30 AM PT Sunday, 90 minutes before kickoff.

flags.what: Questionable, back soreness; DNP Wednesday, limited Thursday, trending to play Sunday @ HOU (Sep 17, 2026).
Questionable, illness; DNP Wednesday, about 91% expected to play Sunday @ BAL (Sep 16, 2026).
Clear RB2 in Tampa Bay behind Bucky Irving; low-volume backup, not startable.

watch.what: Green Bay's OC is calling it 'running back by committee' with Chris Brooks (7 carries Week 1) and Kaleb Johnson also involved; only a lineup option if he clearly separates from that group or Josh Jacobs' exempt-list situation is resolved.
Dropped by a Chargers roster Sep 16 but still buried behind Ladd McConkey (Questionable, chest); only worth a claim if McConkey is downgraded further.
Both Joe Burrow and Malik Willis are off in week 6; no free-agent starting QB with a different bye is on waivers yet, so check again in the next couple of weeks.

alerts.title: 🔁 Start Jones over Shakir tonight
alerts.body: Jordan Mason is headed to IR, making Aaron Jones the Vikings' clear lead back. Swap him in for Khalil Shakir at FLEX before the 5:15 PM PT Thursday kickoff.

alerts.title: 🔁 Set Burrow's AutoSub
alerts.body: Burrow (back) was limited in Thursday practice and is trending to play, but set Malik Willis as his AutoSub before Sunday's 10:00 AM PT kickoff just in case.
